_source: Prydwen build guides, entered by hand and reviewed before committing.
_why_not_scraped: Prydwen's character pages are client-rendered, so a plain fetch returns only navigation chrome, and their Gatsby /page-data/ endpoint answers 410 Gone. Their robots.txt does allow content pages with a 10 second crawl-delay, so a headless render would be permitted - it is just not something the build can do unattended. Entries below are typed in from the published guide.

_shape.key: the GA_<key>_* ability key, so it joins to a capture directly
_shape.variants: one per published priority set (Main DPS, SubDPS, Break, DoT)
_shape.targets: recommended endgame stats, raw stat ids, percentages as fractions
_shape.priority: substat ranking, best first; weights are derived from position
